get.summary: Adds playlist placements to a folder or the root.
get.description: OpenSubsonic extension name `playlistFolders` (as returned by `getOpenSubsonicExtensions`). Adds placements to the authenticated user's playlist organization: files each given playlist in the given folder (or at the root) without touching the playlist's other placements. If the placement already exists, its `sortOrder` is updated instead.

parameters.name: playlistId
parameters.description: ID of the playlist to place. Multiple parameters allowed; playlists are placed in the order given.

parameters.name: playlistFolderId
parameters.description: ID of the destination folder. An empty or omitted value creates an explicit root placement.

parameters.name: sortOrder
parameters.description: Position among siblings, as a client-assigned integer. Multiple parameters allowed, paired in order with `playlistId`. When omitted, added playlists are placed after the existing contents of the destination.
